premises.text: Busy individuals need help managing household chores
premises.evidence_span: Dan needs help. Dan needs the butler you never had for the very first time, the luxury of personal service for the rest of us.

premises.text: Alfred provides a service that automates household management
premises.evidence_span: Alfred anticipates that Dan will need to press that on-demand button, and works and acts in the background, coordinating across multiple verticals.

premises.text: Alfred assigns dedicated service providers to customers
premises.evidence_span: each neighborhood has its own dedicated Alfreds, which visit once a week, every week on set days.

premises.text: Customers can customize their service preferences through the app
premises.evidence_span: Dan can say, I would like for you to check for dry cleaning, laundry, and packages.

premises.text: Alfred can scale by partnering with buildings to serve neighborhoods
premises.evidence_span: we partner with buildings, which allows us to turn on neighborhoods overnight, making us scalable.

premises.text: There is a large market for home services in urban areas
premises.evidence_span: there are 18 million households in just the top 10 cities who can afford this service.

value.text: Alfred provides seamless management of household services for busy individuals
value.evidence_span: Alfred brings together all the services you use seamlessly, going past the last mile to the last meter.

notes: Retention rate and market size are included as premises; no traction metrics coded.
